{{Top|leg}}
'''Milanda Vorgan''' was an [[Archaeologist/Legends|archaeologist]] involved in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Mount Tantiss dig|survey]] of [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] after the [[Battle of Bilbringi (9 ABY)|defeat]] of [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]. However, when she, along with her teacher [[Garv Debble]], attempted to search the mountain, they were stopped by the [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]], who wished to erase all memory of [[Palpatine/Legends|the Emperor]].

By [[38 ABY]], she was [[Professor/Legends|Associate Professor]] of [[Xenolinguistics]] at the [[University of Charmath]]. In that capacity, she authored the paper "[[The Written Word: A Brief Introduction to the Writing Systems of Galactic Basic]]."
